label: Neither EUTHYPHRO_HORN_2 horn holds, from identity, simplicity and approval after nature
meaning: The identity reply, checked: goodness identical with God's nature and God identical with his nature exclude horn 1; approval depending on that nature, with asymmetric dependence, excludes horn 2. Simplicity is used only against horn 1. On the literal reading the same premises give horn 1 (approved because good): the reply takes literal horn 1 and denies its alleged consequence. None of the four premises is established.
